verdict.rationale: Claude Design can pull in external data (Salesforce, QuickBooks, GitHub) and use it to generate on-brand designs, proposals, or campaign plans, which is a limited form of data-driven suggestion, but this is framed around design generation rather than analytical insight delivery, and no evidence shows dedicated 'insights/suggestions' features from uploaded datasets. missing for 10: dedicated data-analysis/insight generation UI, independent corroboration that it surfaces analytical insights (not just design outputs) from imported data.
